# Boxplots for ICMS Batch 1 - DCIS vs. IDC (normalized, log, scaled data)

A summary of the various metabolites can be found in the excel file "DCIS_IDC_Meta_analysis_CS.xlsx". In this Excel file, there are separate tabs for analysis of HILIC Batch 1 and 2 and ICMS Batch 1 and 2. There are also tabs for meta analysis between the 2 batches for both HILIC and ICMS. The DCIS.CCR2high and DCIS.CCR2low groups are combined to a DCIS group, increasing the n from 3 to 6 for the DCIS group.  

Meta analysis of DCIS vs IDC between Batch 1 and 2 is in word file "DCIS_IDC_Meta_analysis_CS.docx". 

Total of 146 metabolites.

```{r readdata1, echo=FALSE}

load(file ="W:/Health Services and Outcomes Research/BEC/Brooke Fridley/consult/Cheng.Nikki/R01 DCIS/data/processed_data/ICMS_processed_data.Rdata")

icms.B1.meta <- read_excel("W:/Health Services and Outcomes Research/BCB/members/Sakitis.Chase/Consult/Cheng.Nikki/Chase_Results/DCIS_IDC_Meta_analysis_CS.xlsx",
                            sheet = "ICMS.Batch.1")

data.trans.icms.B1<-ICMSdata

n.metabolites.icms.B1<-ncol(data.trans.icms.B1)-2

data.trans.icms.B1 <- data.trans.icms.B1 |> filter(Group != "Normal")
data.trans.icms.B1$Group <- str_replace(data.trans.icms.B1$Group,"DCIS.CCR2high","DCIS")
data.trans.icms.B1$Group <- str_replace(data.trans.icms.B1$Group,"DCIS.CCR2low","DCIS")


```



```{r boxplotspvaule, echo=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width  = 3.5,   # inches (choose based on manuscript column width)
  fig.height = 3.0,   # inches
  dpi = 300,
  fig.retina = 1      # important: prevents “retina scaling” side-effects
)


p_vec <- setNames(icms.B1.meta$T.Test.P.Value, icms.B1.meta$Metabolite)

#

#     geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
#     geom_jitter(color = "black", width = 0.15) +
#     ggtitle(metab) +
#     labs(
#       title = metab,
#       y = "Normalized–Standardized Abundance"
#       ) +
# 
#     annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = p_lab, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size=5) +
#     theme(
#       axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
#       axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
#       plot.title  = element_text(size = 10)
#     )
# 
# 
#   print(plot1)
# }

meta_locs <- c(which(colnames(data.trans.icms.B1) == "Riboflavin cyclic-4',5'-phosphate"))


for(i in meta_locs){
  metab <- colnames(data.trans.icms.B1)[i]
  p_val <- unname(p_vec[metab])  # SAFE: returns NA if not found
  p_lab <- if (is.na(p_val)) "p = NA" else paste0("p = ", signif(p_val, 3))

  plot1 <- ggplot(data.trans.icms.B1, aes(x = Group, y = .data[[metab]], fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(color = "black", width = 0.15) +
    ggtitle(metab) +
    labs(
      title = metab,
      y = "Normalized–Standardized Abundance"
      ) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = p_lab, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 19, size=5) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.title  = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  print(plot1)
}



```
